COMMISSION FOR WOMEN AND GIRLS AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, MARCH 25, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 6:30 PM
Samantha Mehlinger, Chair  Helena Donato-Sapp, Commissioner
Irma Archuleta, Vice Chair  Maria Gonzalez, Commissioner
Jennifer Allen Harper, Commissioner  Alyce LaViolette, Commissioner
Dr. Stephanie Anckle, Commissioner  Vanessa Mosqueda, Commissioner

  Commission for Women and Girls Meeting Via In-Person/Virtual Hybrid Meeting Pursuant To
  Gov. Code Section 54953.8.3(c)(3)

  Members of the public have the option to submit online and email public comments
  to alanah.grant@longbeach.gov

  Comments may also be provided in the Zoom meeting using the raise hand function or by
  pressing *9 on your phone

  Please dial: (213) 338-8477 / Meeting ID: 939 3435 2621
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/93934352621

  To view the meeting from your computer, tablet, or smartphone
  visit: https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54689  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Commission for Women and Girls
  meeting of Wednesday, February 25, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54690  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from Councilwoman Thrash-
  Ntuk on the R.E.A.C.T. Strategic Framework and Women’s History Month.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54691  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Long Beach Justice
  Fund Coalition on recommendations to strengthen the Long Beach Values Act as it
  relates to women and girls in Long Beach; and if appropriate, establish an ad hoc
  committee to draft a letter to the Mayor and City Council expressing support of
  implementing the Coalition’s recommendations.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 2
   COMMISSION FOR WOMEN AND GIRLS AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, MARCH 25, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 6:30 PM

4.  26-54692  Recommendation to discuss recent allegations of sexual abuse by Cesar Chavez
  and Jeffrey Epstein and the impact on women and girls in the City of Long Beach,
  and, if appropriate, take action to transmit a letter to the Mayor and City Council
  outlining policy recommendations.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-54693  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Commission for Women and Girls on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact he Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
